hypothesis: Generating six-mark Golomb rulers conditioned on pairs of allocated differences will improve compatibility-aware packing beyond single-anchor conditioning, because each selected row simultaneously satisfies two scarce difference demands.
rationale: Single-anchor conditional generation evenly covered all differences but still reached depth five, matching prior methods. A row contains many coupled differences, yet the prior generator explicitly controlled only one. Pair conditioning changes the allocation unit and may produce rows that jointly cover the constrained high-difference structure encountered late in exact-cover recursion.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether the depth-five ceiling is caused by single-anchor allocation granularity rather than a lack of scope-111 Golomb rulers or exact-cover compatibility.
method: For each unordered pair of distinct differences in 1..111, place those two values as positive marks in a six-mark row, randomly complete the remaining three positive marks, and retain only locally Golomb-valid scope<=111 rows. Generate up to 20 valid rows per pair, deduplicate by exact difference mask, then use the existing scarcity-aware exact-cover recursion over the resulting catalog: probe 24 statically rare uncovered differences, branch on the fewest currently compatible rows, and allow at most six gaps. Validate any complete assignment with the independent integer verifier.
metric: completed anchor pairs, catalog cardinality, valid rows, exact-cover nodes, maximum assembled depth, omitted-difference count, target assignment, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A complete seven-row assignment accepted by the independent integer validator is exactly a true-objective scope<=111 witness; catalog size and partial depth are finite-family diagnostics only.

configuration.cover_branching: fewest currently compatible rows among statically rare uncovered differences plus six-gap budget

kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated target witness, pair-catalog/DFS completion, 120-second wall budget, or 2,000,000 search nodes. Do not infer global impossibility from finite catalog failure.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new multi-anchor allocation unit with same integer exact-cover verifier

interpretation: Pre-registered multi-anchor DTS allocation search; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If a validator-valid scope-111 assignment appears, freeze it and perform independent/adversarial verification and provenance review; otherwise close the conditional-allocation family unless it materially exceeds prior depth ceilings.
repetition_justification: This is a new allocation mechanism, not a seed or budget sweep: each generated row is conditioned on two target differences instead of one, while the target, verifier, and exact-cover contract remain fixed.
